checks: patched sites: held-key register loads -> mc_held, both lock applier calls -> mc_ca_locks, knob-edit entry -> hook
TRK alone goes to the stock path
FUNC + TRK turns Control All on; its repeat and release are consumed; the next plain TRK is stock
held-key query: TRK reads held while on (not while a trig is held); other keys unchanged
knob edits reach the stock cache write and are recorded for Control All
locks on a turned parameter carry the Control All value; missing ones are appended; others untouched
turning it off restores the six sounds, notifies the changed owners and lets step locks through again
a pattern load while on makes its sounds the restore point and drops earlier values
FUNC + SWEEP and FUNC + PITCH move all six tracks by the same amount, each clamped
TRK LED requested lit while on, unlit after
limitations: Synthetic owner tree, kit and lock buffers; stock encoder handlers, popup drawing and the LED controller are stubbed or absent; no audio rendered.
